title: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Soft and chewy, these classic chocolate chip cookies are a beloved treat for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cream together 1 cup (227g) unsalted butter, 1 cup (220g) brown sugar, and 1/2 cup (100g) granulated sugar until smooth.
Beat in 2 large eggs and 1 tsp of vanilla extract until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together 2 1/4 cups (280g) all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, and 1/2 tsp salt.
Gradually add the flour mixture to the butter blend, mixing until just combined.
Fold in 2 cups (340g) of semisweet chocolate chips until evenly distributed.
Drop tablespoonfuls of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them 2 inches apart.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown around the edges.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Wholesome oatmeal chocolate chip cookies offer a delightful chewiness paired with rich chocolate chunks.
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cream together 1 cup (227g) unsalted butter, 3/4 cup (165g) brown sugar, and 1/2 cup (100g) granulated sugar until fluffy.
Beat in 2 large eggs and 1 tsp of vanilla extract until the mixture is well combined.
In another bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups (190g) all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups (135g) old-fashioned oats, 1 tsp baking soda, and 1/2 tsp salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, mixing gently until combined.
Fold in 1 cup (170g) semisweet chocolate chips until evenly mixed throughout the cookie dough.
Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving space in between.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes until the cookies are golden brown.

title: Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Indulge in rich double chocolate chip cookies that are soft, fudgy, and perfect for chocolate lovers.
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cream together 1 cup (227g) unsalted butter, 1 cup (220g) brown sugar, and 1/2 cup (100g) granulated sugar until fluffy and pale in color.
Beat in 2 large eggs and 1 tsp of vanilla extract until well combined and smooth.
In another bowl, whisk together 1 1/2 cups (190g) all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup (50g) cocoa powder, 1 tsp baking soda, and 1/2 tsp salt.
Gradually blend the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, avoiding overmixing.
Fold in 1 cup (170g) semisweet chocolate chips and 1 cup (170g) white chocolate chips until they are evenly distributed.
Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes or until the cookies have slightly puffed and are set.
